title: Great Work Deserves Great Journeys
subtitle: Incentive travel, with a sense of occasion.

storyboard.scene: A sculpted trophy rises from an architectural plinth; reward ribbons unfurl.
The trophy becomes a boarding pass as an aircraft draws a route through an illustrated world.
The route arrives at an original island retreat with a sun, palms, waves and a team gathering.
The setting transforms into an awards evening, complete with a stage, light beams and applause.
Shared Global Connect Travels logo and enquiry end card.
